objective: One timeframe truth. FeaturePipeline, the backtest and the live rail each assumed 15-minute bars without declaring or checking it, so an H4 research check read candle-pattern features that described a 15-minute candle, and an H1/H4 backtest would reset on every bar (gap_reset_minutes=120 < one H4 bar). Add one bar-size table and measurer next to the existing hour-grid authority, make FeaturePipeline and the backtest fail closed when the declared timeframe disagrees with the measured bar size, limit the live rail to M15, name one candle-merging authority and ratchet new hand-rolled merging out, and make three engine telemetry numbers read the declared HTF window and bar size instead of 4 and 15.
change_class_rationale: New guards in FeaturePipeline.__init__ and BacktestRunner raise before a run on a mismatching or impossible timeframe (fail-closed; no behaviour change on M15 data with consistent config). Three telemetry-only expressions in crt_engine_v2 (would_expand score term, dwell/age hours conversions) and one resolver default change logged numbers, not trades. The research scripts under scripts/research/xau_1009_* are edited and re-registered (SITS).
affected_files: src/inout/live_rail/config.py (M15 only; table derived from BAR_MINUTES)
scripts/research/xau_1009_*.py (H1 grouping via research.resample; H4 pattern columns)
docs/reference/conventions.md (one subsection naming the merging authority)
affected_models: none. No feature value, schema, hash or model input changes on M15 data.
affected_production_config: none edited. Reads declared backtest.timeframe, backtest.gap_reset_*, backtest.htf_candles_per_range, parent_crt.timeframe.
behavioral_effects: FeaturePipeline(df, timeframe='M15') raises ValueError when the frame's modal bar interval differs from the declared timeframe; a declared non-M15 timeframe logs one warning that indicator windows are bar counts tuned on M15.

BacktestRunner raises when backtest.timeframe differs from the measured bar size (G3) or when gap reset is enabled with gap_reset_minutes <= one bar (G2). Program 3 H1/H4 qualify_htf runs on a 120-minute gap now stop with an explanatory error instead of resetting on every bar.
live_rail.timeframe other than M15 is refused at config load.

crt_engine_v2 telemetry fields that assumed 4-bar windows and 15-minute bars now use the declared window and bar size; on the active config the would_expand score and CLOCK_DRIFT hour figures change, trades and state sequences must not.
A new test fails on any new hand-rolled OHLC merging in src/, scripts/ or tools/; existing instances sit in a shrink-only allowlist.
unverified_or_deferred: The three OHLC emitters inside the authorities (research.resample._emit, calendar_periods._emit, parent_candle._aggregate) stay separate; merging them needs a parity proof of their volume handling.
inout/live_rail/bar_builder._floor_period floors on epoch seconds and is not calendar-aware above M15; guarded by the M15-only limit, not fixed.
Finding F-027 (H1/H4 spine runs) is not re-measured here; the guard makes its gap-reset behaviour visible but any change to the finding needs user approval.
Research scripts outside scripts/research/xau_1009_* that hand-roll merging are listed in the allowlist, not migrated.
